rows.note: This is the all-purpose choice for something unnecessary or extra, including words that add no useful content.

example.english: This button is redundant; it makes no difference whether you press it.
example.traditional: 呢個按鈕係多餘，撳唔撳都冇分別。
example.jyutping: nei1 go3 on3 nau2 hai6 do1 jyu4 gam6 m4 gam6 dou1 mou5 fan1 bit6

rows.note: Use this specifically when someone loses their job because the employer no longer needs the position.

example.english: Ming was made redundant by his company last month and is now looking for a new job.
example.traditional: 阿明上個月畀公司裁咗，而家搵緊新工。
example.jyutping: aa3 ming4 soeng5 go3 jyut6 bei2 gung1 si1 coi4 zo2 ji4 gaa1 wan2 gan2 san1 gung1

rows.note: Use this for speech or writing that is excessively long, repetitive, or needlessly detailed rather than simply unnecessary.

example.english: Your report is too redundant; you have said the same thing three times.
example.traditional: 你份報告太長氣，講咗三次同一樣嘢。
example.jyutping: nei5 fan2 bou3 gou3 taai3 coeng4 hei3 gong2 zo2 saam1 ci3 tung4 jat1 joeng6 je5
